description: This Java source file defines the class FinancialActivityAccountHelper which provides helper methods for interacting with financial activity account mappings in the Fineract system. It contains methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting financial activity account mappings via REST API calls, both through server utility functions and a typed client API.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to manage financial activity account mappings in Fineract through REST API calls and client models.

methods.name: createFinancialActivityAccount
methods.description: Creates a new financial activity account mapping via both server POST utility and client API.

methods.name: updateFinancialActivityAccount
methods.description: Updates an existing financial activity account mapping via server PUT utility.

methods.name: getFinancialActivityAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a specific financial activity account mapping as a HashMap using server GET utility.

methods.name: getAllFinancialActivityAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all financial activity account mappings as a list of HashMaps.

methods.name: deleteFinancialActivityAccount
methods.description: Deletes a specified financial activity account mapping using server DELETE utility.

methods.name: createFinancialActivityAccount (client API)
methods.description: Creates a financial activity account mapping using the Fineract client API model.

methods.name: getAllFinancialActivityAccounts (client API)
methods.description: Retrieves all financial activity account mappings using the Fineract client API.

methods.name: deleteFinancialActivityAccount (client API)
methods.description: Deletes a financial activity account mapping using the Fineract client API.
